title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% for first time since 2007; Nasdaq slumps over 1% - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Wall Street's main indexes traded lower on Wednesday, pressured by rising crude prices and government bond yields as investors awaited developments from negotiations to end the Middle East conflict, ahead of the high-stakes US-China summit.
